snippet.title: Last Haul - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
#selfpromo This is my game Last Haul (wishlist it on Steam!).

Try the demo on itch.io: https://last-haul.itch.io/last-haul


It's a mining roguelite in open 2D space: you fly a really small ship, mine asteroids and try to get the resources back to base while waves of enemies do their best to stop you. Every zone ends on a boss, and what you mine pays for upgrades to your weapon, your ship or your economy.
